facts.evidence: "Morgan Stanley reports record second quarter 2026 net revenues of $21.3 billion and EPS of $3.46." / "Net revenues were $21.3 billion for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, compared with $16.8 billion a year ago."
"Net income applicable to Morgan Stanley was $5.6 billion, or $3.46 per diluted share, compared with $3.5 billion, or $2.13 per diluted share, for the same period a year ago."

"Institutional Securities reported record net revenues of $11.0 billion, with Equity net revenues reaching $6.3 billion and Investment Banking net revenues at $2.4 billion." (current-quarter figure and 'record' correct; the $7.6 billion year-ago comparative is omitted)
"The Firm reported a return on tangible common equity (non-GAAP) of 26.6%." (basis correctly flagged non-GAAP; the 18.2% year-ago comparative is omitted)
"Equity net revenues reaching $6.3 billion" (figure correct; the 'record' qualifier and the up 69% year-over-year change are omitted)
"Wealth Management net revenues were $8.9 billion, supported by net new assets of $148 billion and a pre-tax margin of 30.5%." (the 'record' qualifier is omitted)

"supported by net new assets of $148 billion" / "just over half of the $148 billion represented inflows related to IPOs of certain clients in the Workplace channel" (the 'record' qualifier is omitted)
"The Board declared a quarterly dividend of $1.15 per share." (the 15-cent increase and the August 14, 2026 payable date are omitted)

"The Board of Directors reauthorized a multi-year common equity share repurchase program of up to $20 billion beginning in the third quarter of 2026." (the absence of a set expiration date is omitted)
"The Standardized Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital ratio was 14.8%." (the 15.0% year-ago comparative is omitted)

claims.claim: Net revenues were $21.3 billion for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Net revenues were $16.8 billion in the year-ago quarter.
Net income applicable to Morgan Stanley was $5.6 billion, or $3.46 per diluted share.
Year-ago net income applicable to Morgan Stanley was $3.5 billion, or $2.13 per diluted share.
Return on tangible common equity, a non-GAAP measure, was 26.6%.
The expense efficiency ratio was 65% for the first half of the year.
Pre-tax income for the quarter was $7.3 billion.
Institutional Securities reported record net revenues of $11.0 billion.
Institutional Securities Equity net revenues were $6.3 billion.
Institutional Securities Investment Banking net revenues were $2.4 billion.
Wealth Management net revenues were $8.9 billion.
Wealth Management net new assets were $148 billion for the quarter.
Wealth Management pre-tax margin was 30.5%.
Investment Management reported net revenues of $1.6 billion.
Investment Management assets under management were $2.0 trillion.
Institutional Securities Equity performance showed notable strength in Asia.
The Board of Directors reauthorized a multi-year common equity share repurchase program of up to $20 billion beginning in the third quarter of 2026.
The release provides no other guidance or outlook.
The Standardized Common Equity Tier 1 capital ratio was 14.8%.
Tangible book value per share, a non-GAAP measure, was $53.18, compared with $47.25 a year ago.
The Firm repurchased $1.5 billion of its outstanding common stock during the quarter.
The Board declared a quarterly dividend of $1.15 per share.
A workforce management action in the first quarter of 2026 impacted approximately 2% of the global workforce.
That workforce management action resulted in $178 million of severance costs.
Certain corporate and commercial real estate loans contributed to the quarter's provision for credit losses.
Just over half of the $148 billion of Wealth Management net new assets represented inflows related to IPOs of certain clients in the Workplace channel.
